I am Dr. Rajesh Kumar Menon, a veterinarian from PAU Ludhiana ( B.V.Sc. & A.H.).
This is Animal Health channel.

My mission is to guide every Animal lover. May it be PETS,Cow,Buffalos. I will be educating on the topics of their management, feeding, disease prevention and treatment part. I will also be covering homeopathy and ayurvedic treatments for your animals.

Need your love and support so that I can reach to the maximum number of animal lovers.

Your's
